name: North Glass
notes: A pancake dome of the Firebliss Patera: rhyolite melted out of the crust round the patera's long-lived basalt (bimodal, as Iceland's and Yellowstone's), risen slowly and degassed, so it oozed out as a flat-topped table of glass-skinned lava instead of exploding. 12 km across, 500 m over its ground, its top at 5633 m; obsidian cliffs, pumice skin. biomes/firebliss/PLAN.md section 1c.

name: Korona dome 1 (NW trench)
notes: A pancake dome of Korona: rhyolite melted out of the granite basement under the tepui sandstone by the corona's plume, risen on a ring fault where the trench cuts through the cover, and oozed out as a flat-topped glass-skinned table. 14 km across, 600 m over its ground, its top at -892 m. biomes/korona/PLAN.md, 'Amendment 2026-11-12'.
